title: Elena's fall and hip fracture
notice: Fictional composite for the demo. Not real people, not clinical advice.

updates.author: anna
updates.text: Mum fell in the kitchen this morning and can't stand up. The ambulance is taking her to St Mary's Hospital A&E. I'm going with her.

recorded_extraction.what: Fell at home and could not stand up
recorded_extraction.quote: Mum fell in the kitchen this morning and can't stand up
taking her to St Mary's Hospital A&E

updates.author: anna
updates.speaker: Emergency doctor
updates.text: The X-ray shows a fracture of the left hip, at the top of the thigh bone. We are admitting her to the orthopaedic ward, Ward 5B, bed 12. The plan is surgery tomorrow morning, she is first on the list at about 9 a.m. She must not eat anything after midnight. Mr Okafor is the consultant in charge of her care.

updates.text: WARD 5B ORTHOPAEDICS. Visiting hours: 11:00 - 13:00 and 17:00 - 20:00. Maximum 2 visitors per bed. Consultant ward round: weekdays 8:30. Ward phone: 020 7946 0123

updates.author: david
updates.text: Booked a flight from Toronto, landing at Heathrow on Wednesday morning. I can do the evening visits from Wednesday.

updates.author: anna
updates.speaker: Orthopaedic surgeon
updates.text: The operation went well. We replaced the top of the hip joint, a half hip replacement. She will start physiotherapy tomorrow and get up with a walking frame. If she is walking safely with the frame, she could go home on Friday.

updates.author: anna
updates.text: Physio got her standing with the frame this morning. She's tired but smiling.

updates.author: david
updates.speaker: Ward nurse
updates.text: She is a little dizzy when she stands up, so the team wants to keep her one more day to be safe. Going home is now planned for Saturday morning.

recorded_extraction.what: A little dizzy when standing; the team keeps her one more day

updates.author: anna
updates.speaker: Mr Okafor, consultant
updates.text: Good morning, Elena. The wound looks clean and you walked well with the physiotherapist yesterday. You can go home today, once the pharmacy has your medicines ready.

updates.author: anna
updates.speaker: Ward nurse
updates.text: I checked with Mr Okafor's team. She was dizzy again after lunch, so she stays with us tonight and goes home tomorrow morning, Saturday.

updates.author: anna
updates.text:
DISCHARGE MEDICATIONS
Patient: Elena Novak (fictional)   Ward 5B   24/10/2026
Paracetamol 1 g four times a day as needed for pain.
Enoxaparin 40 mg injection once a day for 28 days (to prevent blood clots).
Lansoprazole 15 mg once a day.
Continue: Amlodipine 5 mg once a day.
STOP taking Ibuprofen.
FICTIONAL DEMO DOCUMENT - NOT A REAL PRESCRIPTION
